decisions.reason: Rye country bread is an everyday staple of a traditional German bakery and shares production with the core rye range, so it is cheap to keep.
The gold-medal premium raisin stollen is the firm's flagship seasonal and gift product and drives both reputation and revenue.
Seeded rye mixed bread matches steady demand for wholesome breads and needs little extra production effort.
Dark malt rye bread is a niche variety and more exposed to range pruning, as the ancient grain bread was, but its low incremental cost still justifies keeping it.
Marzipan stollen is a classic seasonal gift item that complements the flagship stollen line.
